features.summary: Firefox's media infrastructure received internal refactoring to improve the MediaTrackGraph (the system that manages audio and video processing pipelines). Changes include better handling of lifecycle state, native support for AudioWorklet message passing, and a new direct task dispatcher for more efficient scheduling. These are largely internal improvements that modernize how Firefox coordinates media processing across its architecture.

features.summary: Firefox significantly expanded Vulkan hardware video decoding on Linux, including **full support for newer NVIDIA GPUs** and improved codec coverage. Changes include better HDR metadata handling to prevent washed-out colors in hardware-decoded videos, safer initialization of Vulkan components, cached codec-support detection for better performance, and refinements to content protection synchronization. The work also restored and then refined the NVIDIA block-linear memory layout optimization for video decoding.
